title: Composer Configuration
description: Dependency Inversion at runtime: maps subagent role → provider impl. C0.2 — frozen Wave 0, append-only during Wave 1.

codexReview.description: Optional Codex review-gate settings. Composer owns the trigger points; omit or disable to keep review-gate off.

enabled.description: Master opt-in switch. false keeps Codex review-gate shipped off.

triggers.description: Composer trigger points that may request Codex review.

preCommit.description: Run Codex review before commit when enabled.

postPlan.description: Run Codex review after planning when enabled.

preCommitCommand.description: Codex companion verb for pre-commit review. Omitted = review.

postPlanCommand.description: Codex companion verb for post-plan review. Omitted = adversarial-review.

mode.description: ask: require user confirmation before invoking Codex. auto: invoke without asking. Omitted = ask.

execution.description: foreground: wait for Codex review. background: launch review asynchronously. Omitted = background.

scope.description: auto: infer review scope. working-tree: review local changes. branch: review against base. Omitted = auto.

base.description: Base branch for branch-scoped review. Omitted = main.

model.description: Optional Codex model passed to codex-companion via --model.

codexWarmCache.description: Optional background warm cache for the mechanical Codex pre-commit gate. Omitted or disabled = off.

enabled.description: If true, Stop hooks may warm a cached Codex review verdict for the current diff.

maxAgeMinutes.description: Maximum age for cached pre-commit verdicts. Omitted = 30.

timeoutMs.description: Warm review wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. Omitted = 300000.

codexReviewNotify.description: Optional user notifications for Codex review-gate activity.

desktop.description: If true, use macOS desktop notifications for sync review start and deny events.

codexRescue.description: Optional guidance-only Codex Rescue integration settings.

enabled.description: If true, skills may suggest Codex Rescue for stuck or failing work.

mode.description: ask: request confirmation before rescue. auto: allow documented rescue flow to proceed.

model.description: Model label used in Codex Rescue guidance.

codexLifecycle.description: Optional deterministic policy for deciding when Codex should participate beyond the mechanical review gate. It never invokes Codex by itself.

enabled.description: Master opt-in switch. false keeps lifecycle participation policy off.

mode.description: ask: return ask decisions for qualified events. auto: return run decisions for qualified events.

execution.description: Preferred Codex execution mode when the policy qualifies an event.

model.description: Codex model label to use for lifecycle participation prompts.

totalWallClockMs.description: Hard total_wall_clock_ms cap in milliseconds across one lifecycle run and all fallback roles. Omitted = 900000.

codexLifecycleTriggers.description: Lifecycle stages where Coco may ask the policy whether Codex should participate.

postResearch.description: Consider Codex after a research result is produced.

postPlan.description: Consider Codex after a plan is written, before code.

postCodeApply.description: Consider Codex after code has been applied.

postTestFailure.description: Consider Codex after targeted tests fail.

afterFailedAttempts.description: Consider Codex after repeated failed fix attempts.

preCommit.description: Consider lifecycle policy before commit. The mechanical codexReview preCommitHook remains the hard gate.

stopWarm.description: Consider passive Stop-time warm checks. Keep off unless background participation is desired.

codexLifecycleThresholds.description: Deterministic score thresholds used by composer_codex_lifecycle_decide.

minScore.description: Minimum score required to return ask/run instead of skip.

minExpectedOutputTokens.description: Expected output size that contributes to the lifecycle score.

minChangedFiles.description: Changed-file count that contributes to the lifecycle score.

minDiffLines.description: Diff-line count that contributes to the lifecycle score.

failedAttempts.description: Failed attempts required before the repeated-failure score applies.

codexLifecycleFallback.description: Optional fallback provider roles used when the primary Codex lifecycle provider is unavailable.

enabled.description: When true, lifecycle runs try fallback roles after coderCli is unavailable.

order.description: Provider role fallback order after coderCli. Duplicate coderCli entries are ignored at runtime.

codexPreCommitHook.description: Optional mechanical PreToolUse gate for git commit. Omitted or disabled = off.

enabled.description: Opt-in switch for the mechanical pre-commit gate.

blockOnSeverity.description: Minimum finding severity that blocks commit. Omitted = high.

timeoutMs.description: Review wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. Omitted = 900000.

failClosed.description: If true, reviewer unavailability blocks commit. Omitted = false.

maxConsecutiveBlocks.description: Opt-in anti-oscillation cap. After this many consecutive needs-attention blocks for the same branch/base, allow once with a loud audit entry and reset. Omitted or 0 = disabled.

spendAuthorization.description: Orchestrator behaviour when a real-money provider call is about to be made. Added 2026-05-24 after the first dogfood audit revealed the soft 'always ask' rule was inconsistent across sessions. Optional — omit for the default 'interactive' behaviour.

mode.description: interactive: ask the user 'go' before any priced call (legacy default). auto: proceed without asking, respect the maxUsd caps. deny: refuse all real-money calls; force tape replay / mock providers.

maxUsdPerSession.description: Hard cap on accumulated USD spend across the whole orchestrator session. 0 = no spend; omitted = no cap.

maxUsdPerCall.description: Hard cap on a single provider call's USD estimate. 0 = block everything; omitted = no cap.

providerId.description: Discriminator picked up by ProviderFactory. Must match IProvider.id.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Resolved by ProviderFactory at startup; the key value itself is NEVER stored in this file.

baseUrl.description: HTTP base URL for SDK-based providers (e.g. GLM Anthropic-compat endpoint).

cli.description: argv array for CLIProvider, e.g. ["codex","exec","--sandbox","workspace-write","-c","approval_policy=\"never\""] for coding, ["codex","--search","--ask-for-approval","never","exec","--sandbox","read-only"] for research, or ["agy","--dangerously-skip-permissions","-p"] for agy. The prompt is appended as the final argv item — NEVER shell-interpolated. For `codex exec`, including Codex global flags before `exec`, CLIProvider auto-captures the final message with --output-last-message unless the flag is already present.

maxTokens.description: Per-role override for the provider's default max output tokens. When `thinking.budgetTokens` is set this must be greater than it. Added 2026-05-25 for v0.1.3.

thinking.description: Extended-thinking knob for Anthropic-compat providers (GLM glm-5.2, glm-4.6+, Claude). Ignored by other providers. Added 2026-05-25 for v0.1.3.

type.description: enabled: include the `thinking` block on every call. disabled: explicitly opt out.

budgetTokens.description: Max tokens the model may spend on internal reasoning. Required when type=enabled. Anthropic SDK minimum is 1024.

timeoutMs.description: CLIProvider wall-clock timeout in milliseconds for one attempt. Ignored by non-CLI providers.

totalWallClockMs.description: Hard total_wall_clock_ms cap in milliseconds for one CLIProvider invocation, including all retries. Omitted = timeoutMs.

maxBuffer.description: CLIProvider stdout/stderr buffer cap in characters before the child process is terminated. Ignored by non-CLI providers.

retries.description: CLIProvider retry count after transient failures. Use 0 for fail-fast dispatches such as reviewers.

maxResultChars.description: CLIProvider result projection cap in characters. Set 0 to disable result projection. Ignored by non-CLI providers.
